visual_review.method: All current frames inspected in ordered, labeled contact sheets; repaired frames also inspected at original resolution. The tracked PNG linked by each row is the primary visual artifact.

frames.expected: Four stable IDs, a three-level hierarchy, perspective and orthographic targets sharing one geometry buffer
frames.observed: Four hierarchy rows and colored objects are visible in distinct perspective and orthographic views.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks one shared geometry buffer and distinct targets; pixels alone do not prove buffer sharing.

frames.expected: Right camera revision remains unchanged; both views retain the same document and geometry
frames.observed: Perspective orientation changes while the orthographic composition stays fixed; camera labels change only on the left.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay additionally checks the right camera revision and upload count.

frames.steps: Select Arm in the hierarchy; drag its X handle in the right view
frames.expected: Arm and Joint move together in both views; history remains unchanged
frames.observed: Arm is selected and Arm/Joint shift together in both views with an X handle. History remains 1 on screen.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks unchanged history and equal child world-X preview across views.

frames.expected: One history entry; child local coordinates account for parent scale and Joint follows the composed transform
frames.observed: Arm/Joint positions remain after release; document/history labels advance once to doc 3 / history 2.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay asserts exactly one history increment.

frames.steps: Pick Carrier in perspective and Arm in orthographic
frames.expected: Two local surface anchors produce the same world distance and cyan segment in both views
frames.observed: Cyan segment and endpoints appear in both views; probe label reads 1.783 world units.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks positive equal cross-view distances. No external scientific accuracy or unit calibration is established.

frames.expected: Both targets omit the same half-space; clipped triangles also drive picking; no cap surface
frames.observed: Purple clipping outline appears; the negative-X objects disappear in both views, with enabled X >= 0 controls.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Rendering is visible; the caption claim about picking/occlusion uses the shared implementation, not a separate picking assertion at this step.

frames.expected: Both views update from one derived geometry rebuild/upload
frames.observed: The shared clipping control shows enabled at offset 0.25; both rendered views are clipped, and the status explicitly says Retain X >= 0.25.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay asserts both views are enabled at offset 0.25.

frames.steps: Undo both the offset edit and enabling the plane
frames.expected: Unclipped geometry returns in both views
frames.observed: All four objects return in both views; the shared clipping control shows disabled at offset 0, and the status says full geometry was restored by undo.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay asserts clipping is disabled and offsets are zero in both views.

frames.steps: Drag the Arm X handle again
frames.expected: Both views display a shared preview before commit
frames.observed: Arm/Joint shift during an uncommitted translation in both views while history stays 2. The status explicitly says clipping remains disabled and Escape discards the preview.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: The following cancellation frame and native replay assert restoration without a history commit.

frames.steps: Send Escape through the native event queue
frames.expected: Committed transforms and history are restored in both views
frames.observed: Arm/Joint return to the prior committed positions; probe distance returns to 1.783 and history remains 2.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay explicitly checks unchanged history and descendant transform after synthetic native Escape.

frames.steps: Enter 0.25 via the native text callback, press Enter then Escape
frames.expected: Same public operation validator and shared history as pointer manipulation
frames.observed: Numeric field shows 0.25; Arm/Joint shift and history advances to 3, with distance 2.011.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks one commit through the native text callback; no physical keyboard or IME exercise.

frames.steps: Undo numeric edit; request a delayed mesh, supersede it and poll its old completion
frames.expected: Old completion is rejected; both views retain the last accepted mesh while the latest work remains pending
frames.observed: Both views retain rendered objects and status reports old worker completion rejection.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Rejection counter is asserted by replay; the screenshot alone cannot prove which completion was rejected or pending-worker ownership.

frames.expected: Right image is removed; left target, document and GPU geometry remain usable
frames.observed: Right target shows View disposed / unavailable and Recreate to recover; left remains rendered and usable.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks left READY after disposal. Latest synthetic slow geometry has settled before this frame.

frames.expected: New right target consumes the surviving GPU geometry without another upload
frames.observed: Right view is rendered again next to the surviving left view; shared-upload count stays 11 across disposal/recreation.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks identical surviving geometry ID and no additional upload, beyond the pixels.
